description: Check a LessonDraft (see get_authoring_guide) against its source set — every quote to the character, no TODO, a sound concept graph — then build the lesson and write it to the learner's library. Send the whole draft as draft, written once, in this call; or, after a refusal that returned draft_id, draft_id with scenes: [{at, ...scene}], only the scenes the refusal named, each the whole corrected scene at that index (never draft and draft_id together). Returns {ok: true, course_ref, outline, key_classes, findings: [{level, code, message, hint?}], notice} or {ok: false, errors: [{path, message, hint}], resend?, draft_id?, fix_scenes?, hint?}: no lesson is written. When the errors are about the draft, Studium keeps it: resend "scenes" means fix only the scenes in fix_scenes and send them with draft_id; resend "draft" means fix every error and send the whole draft again (an error concerns the concepts, goal, title, course_id or the order of the scenes). Errors may quote the draft's own keys: keep them from the learner. The outline holds no key: show the learner only what differs from the sketch you showed before writing, never a key. Then start the lesson with start_lesson_session {bundle_ref: course_ref} and relay the notice; but when the result also carries offer_first and display_markdown, show that display_markdown as it is, with the notice, and do what it offers first: "panel" (this client draws Studium's panel), call open_lesson_panel with open_panel; "chat" (the learner last answered in the chat; one link is given), start the lesson here; otherwise a link comes first (open_link: the Studium pane, with lesson_path, from the VS Code extension, or the browser, an address that lives as long as this server) or the command of the assistant's own pane: start the lesson in the chat only if the learner says “here” (open_lesson_panel with open_panel if they say “panel”). An existing lesson is replaced only with overwrite: true, and only a self-study lesson no teacher validated or approved. A draft refused for a learner is offered to them alone by get_study_plan (pass learner_id only when the server plays several learners, persistence.learner_id_fixed absent; there, with no learner_id and no STUDIUM_LEARNER_ID, it serves the resend only). {source_set_id, discard: true} drops the unfinished build get_study_plan offers, when the learner does not want it finished: it is not offered again.

learner_id.description: only when the server plays several learners (persistence.learner_id_fixed absent): one stable id per learner; ignored otherwise

name: create_lesson
